text:
alice.cust: hey @support — since last deploy our streaming responses to /v1/generate are dropping mid-stream. client sees a broken pipe and we’re getting billed for the request as a 5xx. can someone help?

maya_support: sorry about that — can you paste a minimal curl request and a request_id or timestamp we can look up?

alice.cust: here's the curl we use (shortened):
```bash
curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer XXX" "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate?model=rdw-stream-1" -d '\\n{\"input\":\"long prompt...\",\"stream\":true}'
```
request id from our side: req-20240315-9f32

alice.cust: server log snippet attached: 
```
2024-03-15T14:12:08Z write tcp 10.1.2.3:443->203.0.113.12:53210: write: broken pipe
2024-03-15T14:12:08Z http: proxy error: upstream disconnected
```

maya_support: thanks. we're seeing a small spike in streaming 5xx counts for your org in the last hour, tagging SRE. ingrid, ranjit — can you take a look at gateway logs for req-20240315-9f32 and correlated proxy traces?

ingrid_sre: taking a look now. quick note: are you using chunked transfer encoding from client side? sometimes certain proxies close the connection on client half-close signals.

alice.cust: yes we stream chunked responses. our client does a final half-close once it's done consuming. we expect that to be a normal disconnect.

ingrid_sre: got it. initial traces show our gateway returned a 502 at the same time the backend write failed with EPIPE. gateway currently increments 5xx when backend write fails. that may be counting a client-initiated disconnect as a backend failure.

ranjit_eng: I can repro locally with a client that closes mid-read. reproducer: a node client that streams and then calls socket.end() immediately after last chunk — our proxy logs show write to closed pipe and the request is recorded as 502.

ops-bot: Incident ticket created: INC-2024-4521 — "streaming client disconnects counted as 5xx for hosted inference". Paging eng-runtime on-call.

maya_support: billing note: customer says these were billed as full 5xx errors and requests an invoice adjustment for the hour window (2024-03-15T14:00-15:00). can billing_team advise what data you need?

billing_team: please send a list of request_ids and timestamps for the questionable charges. we can put a provisional credit while SRE/eng investigates.

alice.cust: sending a CSV with request ids, timestamps, and charge references. thanks.

ranjit_eng: triage summary — root cause: upstream proxy treats EPIPE from backend write as a gateway/backend failure and increments 5xx. when client half-closes immediately after consuming the final chunk, kernel sends RST/FIN that races with our last write. need heuristic to detect client-side disconnects and not classify as backend 5xx.

ingrid_sre: short-term mitigation: we can change the metric logic to check response status and connection-close reason; if the client closed the socket we log as client_disconnect not backend_error. will put a hotfix to staging.

ranjit_eng: suggested permanent fix: update proxy error classification to: if write error is EPIPE or ECONNRESET and we have evidence of client halfclose within 200ms before error, classify as client_abort. add a retry path where safe (idempotent streams) or avoid counting for billing metrics. adding unit tests.

maya_support: steps back to customer: we'll apply a staging hotfix today and schedule prod rollout after validation. billing will provisionally credit the disputed window.

ops-bot: Staging deployment started: deploy-2024-03-15-hotfix-518 -> staging.

ranjit_eng: PR: https://git.internal/redwood/edge-proxy/pull/518 — adds EPIPE/ECONNRESET heuristics and client_abort metric. tests included.

ingrid_sre: validated staging with the customer repro scenario; staging no longer increments 5xx for client half-close repro.

maya_support: tentative plan: deploy hotfix to prod during low-traffic window tonight; billing will issue a provisional credit and we will reconcile after prod metrics look good.

billing_team: provisional credit issued for org=alice.corp for the 14:00-15:00 UTC window. will update invoice and follow up in ticket.

alice.cust: thanks for the fast turnaround. will watch prod and report any further anomalies. one ask: can you document recommended client behavior to avoid the race?

ranjit_eng: yes — short recommendations we'll provide in the ticket: 1) prefer draining the stream and waiting ~100-200ms before closing the socket, 2) send an explicit final chunk and wait for a short ack/idle period, 3) enable automatic retry on client if you detect an ECONNRESET on last-chunk after receiving payload. we'll add a KB doc.

ops-bot: INC-2024-4521 -> resolved (staging validated, hotfix scheduled for prod). Follow-up task created: ENG-2024-998 add KB and billing reconciliation notes.

maya_support: marking this thread for closure pending prod deploy and billing reconciliation. thanks everyone :thumbsup:

alice.cust: appreciate it — closing on our side after prod deploy confirms fix.
